revision_summary: No fabricated quotes were found, but several fixes are needed before this ships. (1) Fix the internally inconsistent/mislabeled classification at cherry_pick_moments[2] (ts 01:19, 'enthusiasm_signal') \u2014 the described content is bill-pain frustration, not enthusiasm; relabel and anchor it to coaching_philosophy.bill_anchoring rather than leaving schema_reference null, and reconcile it with the adjacent 01:15 entry so the two aren't giving conflicting reads of the same moment. (2) Add the missed scope-creep instance at 00:47 ('The panels we use, I believe that they are 440 watts') \u2014 this is a stronger example of setter_scope_discipline violation than the 00:36 'We do. Yep.' entry currently flagged, and both should be captured or the stronger one substituted. (3) Add the positive knowledge-gap-handling moment at 00:59 ('that's something I don't know... we would need to gather a couple details') as a counterbalancing positive data point per analysis_directives.knowledge_gap_handling \u2014 currently coaching_focus is entirely negative and misses this legitimate good behavior. (4) Revisit the strategic-vs-reactive call at 01:30: the transcript shows no verbal acknowledgment of the customer's soft exit before the rep pivots into verify questions, which favors a reactive/oversight reading over Stage 3's 'the right call' framing; either soften the endorsement or flip to reflect that the rep likely didn't register the deflection rather than strategically overriding it. (5) Loosen the orphaned_flow citation at cherry_pick_moments[0] (00:13) \u2014 the schema's orphaned_flow steps don't include a satisfaction/sales-tactics probe, so frame that coaching suggestion as an improvisation opportunity rather than implying the schema requires it.
